reuse.why: Puts the rule in a shared getRangeAmount that getScheduledAmount also uses, but the server/shared sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: The amount == null ? 0 : number ? value : range dispatch remains copied at five sites (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, normalizeSchedule, schedule-template) next to a helper that does exactly that.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, where amount resolution belongs.

scope.why: Only the range resolution at each site, comments, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Changing the range rule again is a one-line edit, though two parallel helpers and five copied dispatches remain to confuse future readers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule and schedule-template.ts createScheduleList call getRangeAmount inside their own dispatch rather than getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated midpoint arithmetic was removed in favour of one helper; the remaining per-site dispatch is pre-existing, not new or disguised.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getRangeAmount, called by getScheduledAmount and by every server/shared site that resolves a ranged amount.
